_doc: Single source for the strategy card, tool slide, look-back and guide lines (docs/pedagogy/spine_routine_spec.md). Read by levels/spine_wb.js, levels/spine_guide.js and levels/spine_deco.py. Edit wording here only.

tools.name: Spot the pattern

def.A: Look for what repeats or grows.
def.B: Look for what repeats or changes by the same amount, then say the rule.
def.C: Find the rule, test it on a new case, then use it to jump far.

tools.icon_concept: A row of four shapes (circle, triangle, circle, triangle) and a fifth place drawn as a dotted outline circle.

tools.name: List every way

def.A: Write each way down, in order, so none is missed.
def.B: List all the possibilities in an organised order and say how you know you have them all.
def.C: Count every case once with a systematic order; rule out repeats.

tools.icon_concept: Three ruled lines, each starting with a small tick box, each with a different pair of dots (filled/empty swapped).

tools.name: Draw it

def.A: Draw a picture or a bar of what the story says.
def.B: Draw a picture, bar model or number line that shows what is known and what is asked.
def.C: Sketch and label a model; let the picture show what stays the same.

tools.icon_concept: A pencil drawn diagonally, finishing a long bar that is split into three parts.

tools.name: Make a table

def.A: Put what you know in rows and columns.
def.B: Make a table, fill it row by row and look down the columns.
def.C: Tabulate cases, find the change in each column, extend or generalise.

tools.icon_concept: A 3 by 3 grid with a thick top row and one dot in the centre cell.

tools.name: Work backwards

def.A: Start at the end and undo each step.
def.B: Start from the answer and undo each step in reverse order, then check forwards.
def.C: Reverse the operations from the result, then confirm by running forwards.

tools.icon_concept: Two boxes with a long arrow curving from the right box back to the left box.

tools.name: Guess and check

def.A: Pick a number, test it, then try a better one.
def.B: Make a sensible guess, check it against every clue, improve it.
def.C: Guess, check, adjust using how far off you were; stop when every condition holds.

tools.icon_concept: Two stacked small boxes, top box with a cross, bottom box with a tick, joined by a curved arrow.

tools.name: Try something simpler

def.A: Try it with smaller numbers first.
def.B: Solve a smaller version first, then see what changes as it grows.
def.C: Solve 1, 2, 3 cases first, find how the answer grows, then handle the real size.

tools.icon_concept: A large square on the left, an arrow, a small square with a 2 by 2 grid on the right.

tools.name: Act it out

def.A: Use counters, paper or people to show it.
def.B: Use objects, folding or a role-play to see what happens, then record it.
def.C: Model or simulate the situation (objects, fold, cut, dice) and record the outcomes.

tools.icon_concept: Two round-headed simple figures facing each other with one round counter between them.

A: Can I check it another way?
B: Did I answer what was asked?
Does my answer make sense? (Is it about the right size?)
Can I check it another way?
C: Did I answer the question that was asked (with units or a reason)?
Is my answer reasonable? (Estimate or compare.)
How can I check it another way? (Go backwards, estimate or try a smaller case.)

lookback.intro: Pick one problem from today. There are no right answers. You can pass. Nobody reads it out.
lookback.stuck: I am still stuck (my tutor will come)

script.opening_say: Today's tool is {name}. {def} Look for where you use it.
script.opening_do: Point at the card on page 1 of the workbook.
script.choose_do: Point at the row of eight tools on page 1 of the workbook.
script.talk_ask: Where did you use {name} today? What did it help you see?
script.talk_listen: Listen for the tool being named, not the answer.
script.choose_ask: Which tool did you choose, and why?
script.lookback_say: Pick one problem from today. Question 1: did I answer the question? Question 2: does my answer make sense? Question 3: can I check it another way? Tick, write one line, or pass. If you are still stuck, tick the box and I will come.
script.lookback_do: Start the timer. Nobody reads theirs out. Praise a check you saw, not speed. Then stamp journals.
script.check_together: That is what we did in check together.
